description: Supported device driver / runtime combinations. Probe refuses unsupported tuples with device.alert.v1{kind=unsupported_runtime}.

supported_combinations.notes: NVIDIA CUDA 12.4+ with cuDNN 9.x, driver R555+. Supports Ampere (cc 8.0), Ada (cc 8.9), Hopper (cc 9.0), Blackwell (cc 10.0).
ROCm 6.2+ for AMD RDNA2+ GPUs. Requires /dev/kfd, /dev/dri with render group access.
OpenVINO 2025.0+ for Intel NPU (Meteor, Lunar, Arrow Lake). Supports async-infer queue.
CPU baseline. Always available fallback. Supports x86_64, arm64, amd64.

vendor_bug_exclusion_list.issue: CUDA context creation deadlock under high load
vendor_bug_exclusion_list.workaround: Use driver 555.42+ or 560.28.03+ or upgrade kernel to 6.8+

vendor_bug_exclusion_list.issue: OpenVINO LEVEL0 compiler hang on AMX instructions
vendor_bug_exclusion_list.workaround: Use OpenVINO 2025.0.2+ or disable AMX via environment
